description: Time series of type physico-chemistry in Port-Miou basin - PORT-MIOU PROVENCE observatory - KARST observatory network - OZCAR Critical Zone network Research Infrastructure is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centre Européen de Recherche et d'Enseignement des Géosciences de l'Environnement. Data of type physico-chemistry measured on Port-Miou basin within the framework of the PORT-MIOU PROVENCE observatory, that is part of the KARST observatory network. The KARST observatory network aims to strengthen knowledge-sharing and to promote cross-disciplinary research on karst systems, in the framework of the OZCAR Critical Zone network Research Infrastructure. Coverage: Centre Européen de Recherche et d'Enseignement des Géosciences de l'Environnement. The publisher named on the listing is Centre Européen de Recherche et d'Enseignement des Géosciences de l'Environnement. Its keywords include climate-change, groundwater, ir-ozcar, karst, meteorological-geographical-features, atmospheric-conditions. The listing shows 2 download or service links in 0-HTTP--LINK. The listing shows 2026-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
